aliases: do conditioner bars count as liquids for tsa, or are they solids?
are shampoo bars tsa-friendly for carry-on bags?
description: Guidelines for traveling with solid shampoo bars in carry-on and checked luggage.

carryOn.reason: Solid shampoo bars are completely exempt from the TSA 3-1-1 liquids rule. Any size is allowed in carry-on luggage with no quart-sized plastic bag requirement.
conditions: Keep dry in a soap tin, pouch, or travel case to prevent moisture in luggage.

checkedBag.reason: Solid shampoo bars are fully allowed in checked baggage with no quantity or weight restrictions.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring bar soap and solid toiletries on a plane?

travelTips: Switching to a solid shampoo bar frees up space in your quart-sized liquids bag for other liquid cosmetics.

faq.question: Is a shampoo bar considered a liquid by TSA?
faq.answer: No. Solid shampoo bars are not liquids, gels, or aerosols. They are solid items and are completely exempt from the 3-1-1 liquids rule.

faq.question: Can you pack shampoo bars in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, solid shampoo bars are fully permitted in checked baggage without restrictions.

faq.question: Do conditioner bars count as liquids for TSA, or are they solids?
faq.answer: Conditioner bars and shampoo bars are classified as SOLIDS by TSA and international aviation security. They are completely exempt from the 3.4 oz liquid limit and do NOT need to go in your liquids bag.

faq.question: Is there a way to bring my full hair routine on a flight without checking a bag?
faq.answer: Yes! Use solid shampoo bars, solid conditioner bars, and decant remaining liquids into 3.4 oz (100 ml) travel containers inside a clear quart bag.
